store: Tall Apothecary Rack, Sol 6.1 / extra high: adaptive clay, supported leather and restrained rough glass; prototype
rule: Creature crafting materials: hung fibres, open clay for eyes and wet sacs, supported leather tubs for bulky dry parts; rough glass for Ectoplasm and DragonTear, retaining legacy RoyalJelly access. Never mix kinds.
units_split: every one of the 40 places has 2 units (stacks) for each of the four families: 40 x 4 x 2 = 320 units, 80 per family, so any one family can show all 64 slots; a full place = 2 stacks of one kind, a place holding fewer shows a vessel that is only partly full. Not every stack needs its own place: 23 kinds share 40 places.

frame.atlas_rows: 128x128 family atlas; bunker timber/end grain/iron unchanged; 36-47 clay; 24-35 leather grain;16-23 smoky glass;8-15 source liquid tiles;4-7 cord;0-3 swatches

space: Unity prefab space, metres. Origin: the wall plane (back face, z = 0), x centred, y = 0 the foot; front is +z. Blender z-up/-y front -> Unity: ux=-bx, uy=bz, uz=-by. OBJ exported forward -Z, up Y (the mod loads it flipX).
vessel_meshes_doc: one mesh per family in the same OBJ convention as the frame, in local coordinates: origin = the centre of the vessel's footprint at the shelf surface (vessels[].at); draw it at 'at' (no rotation) with the frame's material. Tris: hanging 224, jar 424, crock 464, basket 452.
vessels_doc: one entry per place: 'at' = where its vessel stands (prefab space), 'default' = the family drawn while the place is empty (light on top, heavy below: the order the mod claims places in). A place holding an item draws the vessel of the item's family (item_family) instead: the vessel follows the item. place n = tier * 8 + column; tier 0 is the top, column 0 the left as seen from the front (Blender x ascending, Unity x descending).
groups: place 0..39 = one vessel position (key 'bin' in units_list, which the mod already reads as the group; 'place' repeats it). EVERY place has units for EVERY family: kind = hanging | jar | crock | basket, 2 stacks (fill_step 0..1) each, same position and box in all four. The clear space of every vessel of every family is the same upright cylinder (radius 0.070, height 0.220) standing on crate_floor_centres[place].

_generic.note: fallback for any item without its own layout in a jar, crock or basket (settled heap): a neutral round lump, scaled uniformly so its longest bounds side is fit_longest_m.

_ghang.note: fallback for any item without its own layout in a hanging vessel (hung from the pegs): a neutral round lump, scaled uniformly so its longest bounds side is fit_longest_m.

crop_layouts_doc: crop_layouts: one full vessel per item kind, as apothecary_r2; '_generic' (any other item in a jar, crock or basket) and '_ghang' (any other item in a hanging vessel). A place holding n stacks of a kind shows stacks[0..n-1] of that kind's layout (2 stacks). Per copy: the item's model scaled uniformly by 'scale' (x its true size), turned by rot_quat_xyzw about its bounds centre, that centre at crate_floor_centres[place] + offset. mode 'heap'/'lie'/'tumble': physics-settled (stack k dropped onto stacks 0..k-1); mode 'hang': hung from the vessel's two pegs (long axis vertical, wide side to the front, top 1.5 mm under the peg tip at the top of the clear space; one big bundle per stack, left peg first), inside the gallows' room |x| <= 0.069, |y| <= 0.035. Every layout fits its vessel, so it fits every place of its family.
liquids_doc: one entry per (place, liquid item) for the semi-liquid in a jar (Ectoplasm: pale ghostly green-white): obj = a closed 16-sided prism of height 1 (y 0..1) in this folder, drawn with the frame's material as T(floor) * S(1, (top_y - floor.y) * fill, 1), fill = stacks / 2; floor = bottom centre (prefab space), top_y = its surface when full; radius 0.073 = the jar's narrowest inside minus 5 mm. An item with an entry for its place is drawn as this column, in the place's jar; crop_layouts still has the item's lumps as the fallback.
unit_semantics: units_list: one unit = one stack, 2 per place and family in fill order; kind = the family; copies = the generic lump of that family (a heap for jar/crock/basket, hung from the pegs for hanging) as Fit.Longest copies (centre at position + offset), a fallback only.
physics: heaps: Blender rigid body (Bullet), each copy the convex hull of its item, friction 0.6, restitution 0, damping 0.5/0.95, margin 1 mm, substeps 20, iterations 40, in the cylinder made of passive box slabs; one copy per kind per drop at one of the three lowest well-supported spots of a 1 cm grid x 8 orientations, settled, checked inside the cylinder, then frozen; until no copy fits or the kind's cap (~5200 item triangles per vessel). Hanging: by hand.

prototype.author: Sol 6.1 / extra high
prototype.physics: apothecarytall_r1 settled poses reused and checks rerun; no new physics simulation
prototype.runtime_contract: perPlace adaptive families unchanged; update item_family for eyes/sacs and load glass auxiliary mesh only for jar family

jar.at: same vessel position as its opaque jar base/collar; use separate alpha-capable material
